typical_steps: Acknowledge frustration or issue with an empathetic exclamation
Ask for device and specific behavior, error codes, or error messages
Direct user to relevant help guides or troubleshooting steps
Offer links to share feedback or community forums for UI complaints
Suggest reaching out via phone or chat if further assistance is needed
info_agent_requests: What specific behavior are you experiencing?
What issue are you running into (buffering, freezing, error)?
when_they_escalate_to_dm: Agents escalate to phone or chat when complex troubleshooting or account-specific investigation is required.
phrases: What device are you streaming from?
never_promises: Roll back to the previous UI
Make any promises about implementing specific requests
